svg.text: Estimated middle-income range ($K) in every state
COLOR = LOWER END OF EACH STATE’S RANGE
The same annual household income can fall into different income tiers across states.
ESTIMATE = PEW 3-PERSON BENCHMARK × 2024 BEA STATE RPP ÷ 100
ROUNDED TO NEAREST $1K · D.C. INCLUDED · STATEWIDE AVERAGES
